issue.title: Intermittent CI fail: not landed before mission start

issue.title: Add mocap plugin

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This is a draft to MoCap plugin implementation.
Please let me know is these naming and interface ok.

Links:
[External Positioning](https://dev.px4.io/v1.9.0/en/ros/external_position_estimation.html)
[VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE)
[Proto PR](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/pull/105)

And also I founded that `generate_from_protos.sh` change in [my old PR](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/832/files#diff-a57f500429cc4c02d3ef01ca8a6ac121) was wrong, I'm sorry.
